data.why: The dashboard loads hypnos.load(), which reads the curated PK/PD dataset shipped under dataset/ in the package itself — no uploads, external datasets, or user-provided files are needed.

goals: Compare predicted plasma and effect-site concentration curves across all published PK/PD models for a chosen drug and virtual patient, to see how much models disagree
Identify which models are excluded by applicability envelopes (age, weight/BMI, organ function) for a given virtual patient and why
Quantify model-selection risk via peak divergence and the driver pair of models furthest apart at peak disagreement
Toggle seeded 5-95% prediction bands to see whether model disagreement survives each model's own between-subject variability (separation index, variance decomposition)
Explore the propofol-remifentanil synergy surface and local-anesthetic site-of-injection dominance and double-uncertainty (threshold vs PK) views
Examine developmental (pediatric/neonatal) and pharmacogenomic extrapolation overlays to see which models have fitted standing versus extrapolated, Tier-D coverage

review.summary: The tree captures the dashboard's purpose well: it compares published anesthetic PK/PD models for one virtual patient, shows which models the patient's applicability envelope rules out, and measures the divergence and whether it survives each model's own variability. All ten screens I opened support their nodes. It should be filed after small fixes: state the effect-site rendering gap and the covariate-SD crash, add an inhaled-agent feature, and correct the 'route' wording and the unconfirmed-check statuses.
